points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Does the calendar start the week on Saturday, on the right?
Do the previous and next month arrows point the correct way beside the month name?
Are the time slots from 9:00 to 12:00 all there and in a sensible order?
Is the selected or chosen time slot clear?
Is the doctor name readable and the Confirm booking button easy to spot?
